body: On 2026-11-08 I told the authors of the pieces in combined train fdd8d035 to close their items only after a NEW registered run on the landed commit itself. That condition goes beyond the standing rule, and I withdrew it. One author (Sol-a7bb, w-463c) had already closed correctly and was left believing its record was deficient. Rule: a piece of a combined landing closes on its own registered verification on its exact candidate, plus proof that its contributed paths are byte-identical in the landed tree, plus the same-tree FULLs and a clean pair. Ask for a new registered run only if `done` actually refuses for an open test obligation. Never add conditions beyond the agreed rule.
